argv: in the same replays watch a card grow from its pin and tuck into the pile
the pile is the stack and a break no longer dims (RC17, RC28, RC29)
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** in the same replays watch a card grow from its pin and shrink back onto its place as its entry joins the stack, a grid's cells swipe in, a note's bubble come and go, a passed place's whisper and "N min later" at a break. **Expect:** each moves smoothly and ends where it should; none sticks at the start of its move, jumps when another overlay arrives, or appears at rest without having grown; the clock's digits roll a minute at a time with no stutter of the map under them. (RC7)

argv: press Next twice quickly, open the pile
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** during a replay press Hold, tap the map, press Next twice quickly, open the stack, lock the phone for a minute and unlock, then delete a photo from the viewer. **Expect:** held, everything stands still; Next lands on the next moment and then the one after; the viewer holds the replay; a locked screen never skips to the card; after the delete the replay goes on from the same place. (RC5, RC8)

argv: the card flies from its pin and back to the pile
replay ceremony RC7, RC28 (decision 0206): the card shrinks onto its place; the overlays are written with setNativeProps
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** play a replay with notes, photos and a memo. **Expect:** the overlays' motion with per-frame styles written on the views (`setNativeProps`, since the replay ceremony's engine; the clock's reels through `Animated`) is smooth: the rolling clock's reels roll, the card grows from its pin and shrinks back onto its place, the bubbles come and go. (RR8, RR9, RR11)

argv: open the pile's viewer while it plays
replay ceremony RC29 (decision 0206): the stack replaced the pile
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** in a replay, start a memo by hand, tap Hold and then go on; open the stack's viewer while it plays. **Expect:** a memo started by hand resumes after Hold, and pauses under the native viewer Modal. (RR7, RR13)

argv: then watch a replay with photos to its pile
replay ceremony RC29 (decision 0206): the stack replaced the pile
ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on a phone with a few hundred photos, scroll the Media gallery to the bottom and back fast, open a moment and come back, then watch a replay with photos to its end. **Expect:** every tile and card shows its own picture (never another tile's after a fast scroll back), pictures already seen show at once without a flash, nothing fades in, and the app's memory settles once the scroll stops (expo-image's memory and disk cache). (EI6)
